main.description: A reply to someone else's net.bisks.rateyourbuild.rating review, or to another reply — same shape either way, so replies can thread. One record per (replier, subject, target) — replying again to the same target overwrites the previous reply in place, RateYourMusic-comment-thread style. Written and read by rateyourbuild (https://rateyourbuild.bisks.net).

subject.description: The bare name of the rated site — same value as the rating record's subject.

reviewer.description: DID of whoever this reply targets: the original review's author for a top-level reply, or another replier's own DID for a threaded reply to their comment.

createdAt.description: When this reply was last written, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
